notes: Modified cash basis school district, governmental funds only (no enterprise funds; school nutrition is a nonmajor governmental fund). Receipts/disbursements from the Governmental Funds statement Total Governmental Funds column (pp4-6). 'Other local receipts' 216,293 split using the report's own fund schedules (pp8, 11, 12); nonrevenue receipts 33,452 split using p14 (Proceeds from disposal 28,945, Insurance adjustments 4,507). Beginning cash = beginning fund balance 6,239,173 (p6; the statement of activities p2 prints 6,239,174). Cash/investments (incl. investment pool 1,564 and county treasurer cash) are all inside cash balances; no separate investments recorded. Balance sheet taken from the net position section of the Statement of Activities and Net Position (p3); no liabilities printed. Detail: General Fund recorded from the budget-and-actual schedule (pp12-15) by function code (no object breakdown, so 'not itemized'); the General Fund Components combining schedule (pp8-10) and nonmajor combining schedule (p11) duplicate fund schedules and were not entered again. Other funds from their individual budget-and-actual schedules (pp17-22). GF schedule total disbursements 6,928,884 includes the 262,556 transfer (shown as other financing); the transfers in nutrition (187,556) and activities (75,000) match. Depreciation Fund transfer 450,000 from the General Fund was disbursed through GF spending lines; the combining schedule (pp9-10) eliminates it (reclassification: vehicles 70,000, buildings 100,000, capital outlay 280,000), so GF detail has contra expenditure lines for those groups plus a -450,000 other financing line matching the Depreciation Fund +450,000 (GF printed total 6,928,884 unchanged). State (17,584) and federal (209,174) programs are reclassified into instruction on p10. Lines with blank 2025 actuals (budget only) were skipped. The 2024 comparative columns were ignored. Read pages 1-10 of 22, 11-20, 21-22: Read pages 1-22 of 22 Activities Fund receipts 198,022 are labelled 'Contributions and donations' on p11 (top-level receipt categorized donations/contributions) but 'Activities receipts' on p22 (detail categorized charges for services/fees, student activity receipts); flagged review. Support services 'Students' 584,876 (p5) split by its printed fund columns: General Fund 286,848 (support services) and Other Governmental 298,028, which p11 shows is the Activities Fund (student activities).

decision_needed.question: The $450,000 sent to the Depreciation Fund comes out of General Fund vehicles ($70,000), buildings ($100,000) and capital outlay ($280,000) per the p10 reclassification, but the General Fund's only capital outlay line is $95,000, so it now nets negative. Keep it this way, or move part of the $280,000 to other lines?
decision_needed.recorded_as: contra expenditure lines (-70,000 / -100,000 / -280,000) plus a -450,000 transfer out

decision_needed.question: The Activities Fund's 198,022 of receipts is labelled 'Contributions and donations' on the nonmajor combining schedule (p11) but 'Activities receipts' on its budget schedule (p22). Should it count as donations/contributions or as charges for services (student activity receipts)?
decision_needed.recorded_as: receipts: donations/contributions (p11 label); detail: charges for services/fees, student activity receipts (p22 label)
